name: Jean-Marie Le Pen
role: Founder and president of the French National Front (1972–2011), presidential candidate and member of the European Parliament
summary: Jean-Marie Le Pen led the French National Front for four decades. His programmes call for ending immigration and family reunification, reserving welfare and nationality for French citizens, restoring the death penalty, leaving NATO and Schengen, rejecting EU supranational powers, protectionism, school vouchers, nuclear energy and referendums, while opposing gay marriage and abortion.

reduce-immigration.rationale: His 2007 programme ends family reunification, leaves Schengen, ends automatic nationality and expels illegal immigrants; the 2002 programme says to reverse the flow of immigration and in 1990 he called the National Front "resolute enemies of immigration coming from the third world".

open-borders.rationale: The 2007 programme restores national borders by leaving the Schengen area and denouncing the treaties that give the EU powers over immigration, asylum and visas.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Reserves social aid and family allowances to French nationals only (2007) and gives family benefits only to French nationals (2002).

allow-dual-citizenship.rationale: The 2007 programme proposes a reform of nationality law abolishing dual nationality.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Would end automatic acquisition of nationality, which would be automatic only for a child of a French father or mother; other acquisition would depend on good conduct and integration.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Calls for a policy of assimilation of those who respect French laws and customs, once new immigration has stopped; the wording is conditional and does not say original culture must be given up.

elite-replacement.rationale: The programme says the anti-family policy has a deliberate objective: to replace French demographic policy with a policy of settling immigrants ("une substitution de population").

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The 2002 programme repeals the constitutional revision allowing foreigners to vote, and the 2007 programme rejects the right of foreigners to vote.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: The 2007 programme says the family rests on a man and a woman and promises to oppose any demand to create gay marriage or adoption by same-sex couples.

traditional-family.rationale: The 2007 programme calls the family the basic cell of society and promotes the family model with a parental income and family allowances.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Proposes a parental income of the minimum wage for parents and family allowances to revive French births.

paid-care-work.rationale: His parental income pays mothers or fathers who choose to stay home with children, which is payment for unpaid home care.

abortion-legal.rationale: Says he is against abortion and wants fewer of them, yet prefers incentives to repression; he does not say the law should end it, so the answer is a partial disagreement.

assisted-dying.rationale: The 2007 programme refuses medically assisted euthanasia while allowing an end to therapeutic persistence.

death-penalty.rationale: Both programmes restore the death penalty for the gravest crimes, and the 2002 programme puts it to a referendum.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Wants prompt and incompressible sentences and a review of systematic sentence remission.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Proposes to regulate the right to strike to guarantee a minimum service in public services.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Calls for protecting children against pornographic violence and for enforcing the 1949 law on publications for youth.

proportional-representation.rationale: Introduces full single-round proportional representation in legislative, European, regional, cantonal and municipal elections.

direct-votes.rationale: Creates a national referendum of popular initiative (2007) and widens referendums to immigration, nationality law and the death penalty (2002).

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Restores a seven-year presidential term that cannot be renewed.

party-controls-media.rationale: Wants the independence of press and broadcasting restored and the political neutrality of public broadcasting reaffirmed.

school-vouchers.rationale: Creates a school voucher (chèque scolaire) giving all parents free choice of school and phases out the school map.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Sets up targeted protectionism at national and European level, and a "new protectionism" restoring trade frontiers in 2002.

free-trade.rationale: Blames world free trade for relocations and proposes to limit "libre-échangisme" and restore trade frontiers.

abolish-income-tax.rationale: The 2002 programme progressively abolishes income tax; in 2003 he defended the proposal on air.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Abolishes inheritance duties in the direct line (2002) and blames the succession tax for forced business sales (2007).

farm-price-support.rationale: Promises farmers a decent income, a moratorium on farm debts and defence of the family farm.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Continues the nuclear effort: third and fourth generation reactors programmed, the fast breeder relaunched.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Maintains a credible nuclear deterrent (2007) and modernizes strategic nuclear forces (2002).

conscription.rationale: Proposes a voluntary six-month military service and says the old compulsory service cannot be recreated.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Renegotiates European treaties to restore the nation-state (2007), denounces Maastricht, Schengen and Amsterdam and abolishes the Commission (2002); in 2019 he called the European Parliament useless.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Calls for France to withdraw its participation in international criminal courts, which he says feed past conflicts and carry arbitrariness.

non-intervention.rationale: Lists non-interference in other states internal affairs as a principle of peace and called the 2003 Iraq war an unjust, illegal, immoral war of aggression.

nation-first.rationale: Says the nation is the best defence of liberty and rejects internationalism and cosmopolitanism; the 2007 programme puts sovereignty first.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The 2007 programme has an urgent plan for national cultural heritage and the 2002 programme promises better teaching of the cultural heritage.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Abolishes the principle of positive discrimination in his immigration programme, criticising it in entry to elite schools.

gm-crops.rationale: Bans imports of GM soy and GM-fed meat but keeps GMO research in confined spaces.
